predicates.cg_quote: In its REACTION field, match reaction IDs exactly against that ALL_REAC set.

predicates.cg_quote: A comma-separated reaction ID list applies the line to each listed reaction.

predicates.cg_quote: Keep only lines that explicitly consume D-ribulose 1,5-bisphosphate (C01182).

predicates.cg_quote: Read -> or => from left to right, and <- or <= from right to left.

predicates.cg_quote: Do not reverse a one-way arrow to make a line qualify.

predicates.cg_quote: Form each product set from only the compound IDs explicitly written on that line's product side.

predicates.cg_quote: Ignore coefficients and compound order; deduplicate IDs.

predicates.cg_quote: Return all qualifying module rows for each retained reaction, including rows that share a product set.

predicates.cg_quote: Exclude reactions represented in only one qualifying module or with identical product sets throughout.

ambiguity_checks.topic: Primary versus full enzyme reaction scope
ambiguity_checks.reading_a: Only the first ALL_REAC reaction is eligible.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_records: A excludes the differing reaction and yields no retained pairs; B retains the two supplied R03140 pairs.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: complete_reaction_scope explicitly includes other in both variants.

ambiguity_checks.topic: Module products versus generic reaction products
ambiguity_checks.reading_a: Use the generic EQUATION products for each occurrence of the reaction.
ambiguity_checks.reading_b: Use each module REACTION line's explicit product IDs.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_records: A makes the two R03140 module product sets agree and removes them; B retains both.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: line_local_explicit_products and no_product_supplementation explicitly select B.

ambiguity_checks.reading_a: Compare all module rows under the same enzyme together.
ambiguity_checks.reading_b: Compare only rows sharing the same reaction ID.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_records: A can include the ordinary R00024 pair alongside the differing enzyme-associated sets; B excludes its singleton group.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: group_identity_and_difference_threshold and singleton_and_uniform_exclusion explicitly select B.

ambiguity_checks.topic: Absent annotation versus empty product set
ambiguity_checks.reading_a: Assign an empty product set where a linked module does not list the reaction.
ambiguity_checks.reading_b: Generate no pair for an absent matching annotation.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_records: A creates additional pairs and a spurious difference for R00024; B excludes its singleton group.

ambiguity_checks.topic: Enzyme naming direction versus written module direction
ambiguity_checks.reading_a: Apply the enzyme's named reaction direction, in which C01182 is formed.
ambiguity_checks.reading_b: Use the direction written on each module line.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_records: A can discard the module lines as nonconsuming; all three matching module lines consume C01182 under B.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: written_one_way_direction, target_consumption, and no_one_way_reversal fix the interpretation.

ambiguity_checks.topic: Representatives versus all qualifying module pairs
ambiguity_checks.reading_a: Report only one unusual module or one representative per product set.
ambiguity_checks.reading_b: Report every qualifying pair in each differing reaction group.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_records: Selecting only the module with an additional explicit product would omit one required pair. With additional agreeing modules, representative-per-set reporting would also omit pairs.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: all_rows_and_shared_sets and output_size_and_composite_key explicitly select B.

ambiguity_checks.topic: Order, multiplicity, reversibility, and conflicting duplicates
ambiguity_checks.reading_a: Product order or coefficients can distinguish sets; reversible lines are always read left-to-right; conflicting duplicate pairs can be unioned.
ambiguity_checks.reading_b: Compare ID membership only, orient reversible lines by unique-side C01182 consumption, and leave conflicting duplicate pairs unresolved.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_records: No extra differences arise from these cases in the supplied matching lines. As a semantic thought experiment, reordered equal products, C01182 on the right of a reversible arrow, or two conflicting lines for one pair would produce different outcomes under A and B. These are not claimed source records or executed tests.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: set_semantics, reversible_direction_and_both_sides, and duplicate_pair_and_conflict explicitly select B.
